_readme: Expected fleet identity state, asserted against live GitHub and GCP by tools/iam-contract/check.mjs and scheduled by .github/workflows/iam-contract-audit.yml. docs/fleet-credentials.md is the prose; this file is the part a machine can check. Change them together (jlapenna/agent-lcars#1376).
_fleetRepositoriesNote: Must stay identical to local.github_repositories in infra/terraform/main.tf - the shared 'github' WIF pool's attribute_condition is generated from it, and tools/contract-tests/iam-contract-model.test.ts asserts the two agree without needing any credentials.

githubApps._note: What the agent lanes and the console authenticate as - claims, PRs and comments land as agent-lcars[bot]. Private key: Secret Manager AGENT_LCARS_APP_PRIVATE_KEY (project agent-lcars) / repo secret AGENT_LCARS_PRIVATE_KEY.

installations._note: jlapenna/homegit is not a fleet agent repo; it is installed so the App can read/write the dotfiles repo. Listed here so its presence is documented rather than surprising.
supersprinklesracing/www is deliberately absent - see fleetCoverageExceptions.

Non-fleet personal org. repository_selection is 'all', so this installation's repository list grows whenever a repo is created in jlaorg; a new repo here is expected drift and the fix is to update this list.

githubApps.uncheckableReason: GET /app and GET /app/installations only accept a JWT signed by that App's own private key, and this App's key lives in the homelab vault (github_autoscaler_lcars_app_private_key), never in this repo. Documented installations: 154210710 (jlapenna) and 154210731 (supersprinklesracing). Asserting them needs the same check run from homelab with that key - jlapenna/homelab#763.

fleetCoverageExceptions.reason: The shared 'github' WIF pool trusts www and Terraform provisions its codex lineage (#1354), but the fleet App is not installed on it yet: adding a repo to an installation needs a GitHub-App user token, so it is a maintainer UI action. Discovered by this check on its first live run (#1376). Remove this entry once www is added to installation 150568991.

_fleetCoverageNote: Every entry in fleetRepositories must appear in exactly one checkable App installation's repositories list, unless it is listed above with a reason. An exception whose repository has since been installed is itself a failure, so the list can only shrink.
_userManagedKeyNote: No fleet service account should hold a user-managed key. The allowlists above are a ratchet: an unlisted key is a failure, and a listed account that no longer holds a key is ALSO a failure, so a retired exemption cannot be silently inherited by the next key.

agent-lcars._note: Terraform-managed by infra/terraform in this repo.

userManagedKeyAllowlist.reason: The host writer credential (Secret Manager AGENT_TELEMETRY_WRITER_KEY_JSON) is consumed by the homelab telemetry watcher outside GitHub Actions, which has no OIDC identity to federate. Every other fleet identity authenticates over WIF and must hold no key.

supersprinklesracing._note: claude-agent-pool is Terraform-managed by jlapenna/homelab (terraform/gcp_sprinkles_wif.tf, homelab#750): change its condition THERE. gcloud ... update-oidc --attribute-condition replaces rather than appends.

supersprinklesracing.svc.id.goog._note: GKE workload-identity pool, created and owned by GCP. ListWorkloadIdentityPoolProviders is not supported on it, so only its existence and state are asserted.

userManagedKeyAllowlist.reason: Pre-existing sprinkles key, recorded as of #1376; retirement tracked by sprinkles' runtime-key work.
Pre-existing Firebase Admin SDK key, recorded as of #1376.
Pre-existing sprinkles key, recorded as of #1376.
Pre-existing sprinkles key, recorded as of #1376.
Pre-existing App Hosting compute key, recorded as of #1376.
Pre-existing sprinkles deploy key, recorded as of #1376.

secretIamPolicies.rationale: Exactly one binding. Two speculative accessor grants were added while chasing #1368 and pruned the same night; nothing but this check stops the next ones from persisting. The reader is claude-token-reader, impersonated by every fleet repo through the shared 'github' pool.
